fn next_row(prev List[Int]) List[Int]
  1..<len(prev) |> reduce(List(prev(0)), (acc, j) -> acc + (prev(j) + acc(j - 1)))
fn paths(rows Int, cols Int) Int
  first = List(1 for _ in 0..<cols)
  last = 1..<rows |> reduce(first, (prev, _) -> next_row(prev))
  last(cols - 1)

fn step(prev List[Int], acc List[Int], ys List[Char], x Char, j Int) Int
  if ys(j - 1) == x
    prev(j - 1) + 1
  else
    max(prev(j), acc(j - 1))
fn lcs_row(prev List[Int], x Char, ys List[Char]) List[Int]
  1..len(ys) |> reduce(List(0), (acc, j) -> acc + step(prev, acc, ys, x, j))
fn lcs(a String, b String) Int
  xs = List(c for c in chars(a))
  ys = List(c for c in chars(b))
  last = xs |> reduce(List(0 for _ in 0..len(ys)), (prev, x) -> lcs_row(prev, x, ys))
  last(len(ys))

type EchoServer = session.Offer[session.Recv[Int, session.Send[Int, EchoServer]], session.End]

fn serve(e session.Endpoint[EchoServer]) Result[Unit, Error]
  when session.offer(e)?
    session.Branch.Left(e2) ->
      (n, e3) = session.recv(e2)?
      e4 = session.send(e3, n * 2)?
      serve(e4)
    session.Branch.Right(e2) -> Ok(session.finish(e2))

fn ask(c session.Endpoint[EchoClient], n Int, total Int) Result[Int, Error]
  if n == 0
    c2 = session.pick_right(c)?
    session.finish(c2)
    Ok(total)
  else
    c2 = session.pick_left(c)?
    c3 = session.send(c2, n)?
    (r, c4) = session.recv(c3)?
    ask(c4, n - 1, total + r)
